Mina — pilot should be single region (us-west-2) and one tenant (our payments sandbox). Pilot success criteria: p99 < 150ms, error rate <0.5%%, no more than two critical regressions in the regression suite.

For governance, the security team requires: SOC2 evidence, network flow diagrams showing egress destinations, and KMS integration notes. Procurement will push standard 30/60 payment terms but can escalate for accelerated onboarding.

-Luis

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Anita Shah <anita.shah@stratacorp.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:18:34 -0700
Subject: Re: RFP follow-up: activation sequencing and telemetry expectations

Anita / Luis / team — attaching inline guidance and a short engineering-runbook excerpt below. High-level items we recommend (summary):

1) Activation phases (pilot -> regional -> global)
   - Pilot (week 0-2): us-west-2, single tenant, 5%% of non-prod traffic, smoke and regression suites nightly.
   - Regional ramp (week 3-6): add us-east-1, scale to 25%% of production traffic with canary evaluation windows of 4 hours.
   - Global (week 7-10): full traffic shift with staged DNS / egress controls.

2) Gates & metrics (per phase)
   - Latency P95/P99 thresholds (we'll provide target numbers per model/profile).
   - Error budget check: <1%% infra errors, <2%% application errors.
   - Quality regression: prompt suite A has zero critical regressions; prompt suite B tolerance = 1 non-critical.

3) Rollback criteria
   - Any sustained p99 violation > 30 minutes, or >3 critical regressions in 24h -> immediate rollback to previous model bundle.

4) Telemetry we will emit (examples)
   - Metrics: token/sec, model_latency_ms.{p50,p95,p99}, kv_cache_hit_ratio, batch_size_avg, infra_error_rate
   - Traces: end-to-end request traces with model invocation spans and routing decision annotations
   - Logs: structured request/response metadata (sanitized), deployment events, circuit-breaker triggers

5) Network & governance checklist (owner: Redwood infra ops)
   - Egress IPs and DNS names: list in network_config_snippets.txt (attached)
   - KMS integration: customer-managed CMKs supported; we will work with your security to exchange key policies.

6) Planned blackout windows
   - Non-production: rolling maintenance Tuesday 02:00-06:00 UTC during pilot.
   - Production: we recommend a 2-hour blackout during final cutover (week 9) between 02:00-04:00 UTC, to minimize user impact. Any change outside this requires signed approval.

Attached: network_config_snippets.txt

If you want, we can convert this to a one-page swimlane timeline and include assigned approvers per gate. Next steps: Mina / Marissa will finalize the spreadsheet and provide a versioned runbook with DocuSign-ready acceptance checklists for procurement.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Sr. Technical Program Manager, Redwood Inference
[attachment: network_config_snippets.txt (text/plain)]
